sql: SELECT country,year,month,to_us FROM currency WHERE lower(country)='france' ORDER BY year,month

SELECT co.country_name,t.calendar_year,t.calendar_month_number,COUNT(*) rows,COUNT(DISTINCT s.prod_id) products,SUM(s.amount_sold) sales FROM sales s JOIN customers c USING(cust_id) JOIN countries co USING(country_id) JOIN times t USING(time_id) JOIN promotions p USING(promo_id) JOIN channels ch USING(channel_id) WHERE co.country_name='France' AND p.promo_total_id=1 AND ch.channel_total_id=1 GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 2,3

WITH h AS (SELECT s.prod_id,t.calendar_year y,t.calendar_month_number m,SUM(amount_sold) a FROM sales s JOIN customers c USING(cust_id) JOIN countries co USING(country_id) JOIN times t USING(time_id) JOIN promotions p USING(promo_id) JOIN channels ch USING(channel_id) WHERE co.country_name='France' AND p.promo_total_id=1 AND ch.channel_total_id=1 AND t.calendar_year IN(2019,2020) GROUP BY 1,2,3), paired AS (SELECT prod_id,m,MAX(CASE WHEN y=2019 THEN a END) a19,MAX(CASE WHEN y=2020 THEN a END) a20 FROM h GROUP BY 1,2), projected AS (SELECT prod_id,m,a19,a20,a20*a20/a19 projected,COALESCE(cur.to_us,1) rate FROM paired LEFT JOIN currency cur ON cur.country='France' AND cur.year=2021 AND cur.month=m WHERE a19>0 AND a20 IS NOT NULL), monthly AS (SELECT m,ROUND(AVG(projected*rate),2) monthly_avg FROM projected GROUP BY m) SELECT m,COUNT(*) products,SUM(a19) sales_2019,SUM(a20) sales_2020,MIN(projected) min_projection,MAX(projected) max_projection,ROUND(AVG(projected*rate),2) monthly_avg FROM projected GROUP BY m ORDER BY m

WITH h AS (SELECT s.prod_id,t.calendar_year y,t.calendar_month_number m,SUM(amount_sold) a FROM sales s JOIN customers c USING(cust_id) JOIN countries co USING(country_id) JOIN times t USING(time_id) JOIN promotions p USING(promo_id) JOIN channels ch USING(channel_id) WHERE co.country_name='France' AND p.promo_total_id=1 AND ch.channel_total_id=1 AND t.calendar_year IN(2019,2020) GROUP BY 1,2,3), paired AS (SELECT prod_id,m,MAX(CASE WHEN y=2019 THEN a END) a19,MAX(CASE WHEN y=2020 THEN a END) a20 FROM h GROUP BY 1,2), projected AS (SELECT prod_id,m,a19,a20,a20*a20/a19 projected,COALESCE(cur.to_us,1) rate FROM paired LEFT JOIN currency cur ON cur.country='France' AND cur.year=2021 AND cur.month=m WHERE a19>0 AND a20 IS NOT NULL), monthly AS (SELECT m,ROUND(AVG(projected*rate),2) monthly_avg FROM projected GROUP BY m) SELECT m,COUNT(*) product_months,SUM(a19 IS NULL) missing_2019,SUM(a20 IS NULL) missing_2020,SUM(a19=0) zero_2019 FROM paired GROUP BY m ORDER BY m

WITH h AS (SELECT s.prod_id,t.calendar_year y,t.calendar_month_number m,SUM(amount_sold) a FROM sales s JOIN customers c USING(cust_id) JOIN countries co USING(country_id) JOIN times t USING(time_id) JOIN promotions p USING(promo_id) JOIN channels ch USING(channel_id) WHERE co.country_name='France' AND p.promo_total_id=1 AND ch.channel_total_id=1 AND t.calendar_year IN(2019,2020) GROUP BY 1,2,3), paired AS (SELECT prod_id,m,MAX(CASE WHEN y=2019 THEN a END) a19,MAX(CASE WHEN y=2020 THEN a END) a20 FROM h GROUP BY 1,2), projected AS (SELECT prod_id,m,a19,a20,a20*a20/a19 projected,COALESCE(cur.to_us,1) rate FROM paired LEFT JOIN currency cur ON cur.country='France' AND cur.year=2021 AND cur.month=m WHERE a19>0 AND a20 IS NOT NULL), monthly AS (SELECT m,ROUND(AVG(projected*rate),2) monthly_avg FROM projected GROUP BY m) , ranked AS (SELECT monthly_avg,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY monthly_avg) rn,COUNT(*) OVER() n FROM monthly) SELECT AVG(monthly_avg) median_monthly_projected_sales_usd FROM ranked WHERE rn IN ((n+1)/2,(n+2)/2)

WITH h AS (SELECT s.prod_id,t.calendar_year y,t.calendar_month_number m,SUM(amount_sold) a FROM sales s JOIN customers c USING(cust_id) JOIN countries co USING(country_id) JOIN times t USING(time_id) JOIN promotions p USING(promo_id) JOIN channels ch USING(channel_id) WHERE co.country_name='France' AND p.promo_total_id=1 AND ch.channel_total_id=1 AND t.calendar_year IN(2019,2020) GROUP BY 1,2,3), paired AS (SELECT prod_id,m,MAX(CASE WHEN y=2019 THEN a END) a19,MAX(CASE WHEN y=2020 THEN a END) a20 FROM h GROUP BY 1,2), projected AS (SELECT prod_id,m,a19,a20,a20*a20/a19 projected,COALESCE(cur.to_us,1) rate FROM paired LEFT JOIN currency cur ON cur.country='France' AND cur.year=2021 AND cur.month=m WHERE a19>0 AND a20 IS NOT NULL), monthly AS (SELECT m,ROUND(AVG(projected*rate),2) monthly_avg FROM projected GROUP BY m) , ranked AS (SELECT monthly_avg,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY monthly_avg) rn,COUNT(*) OVER() n FROM monthly) SELECT AVG(monthly_avg) median_monthly_projected_sales_usd FROM ranked WHERE rn IN ((n+1)/2,(n+2)/2)

WITH h AS (SELECT s.prod_id,t.calendar_year y,t.calendar_month_number m,SUM(amount_sold) a FROM sales s JOIN customers c USING(cust_id) JOIN countries co USING(country_id) JOIN times t USING(time_id) JOIN promotions p USING(promo_id) JOIN channels ch USING(channel_id) WHERE co.country_name='France' AND p.promo_total_id=1 AND ch.channel_total_id=1 AND t.calendar_year IN(2019,2020,2021) GROUP BY 1,2,3),p AS (SELECT prod_id,m,MAX(CASE WHEN y=2019 THEN a END) a19,MAX(CASE WHEN y=2020 THEN a END) a20,MAX(CASE WHEN y=2021 THEN a END) a21 FROM h GROUP BY 1,2),v AS (SELECT 'paired_all' variant,m,a20*a20/a19 v FROM p WHERE a19>0 AND a20 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'paired_2021_roster',m,a20*a20/a19 FROM p WHERE a19>0 AND a20 IS NOT NULL AND a21 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT '2020_roster_missing_2019_zero',m,COALESCE(a20*a20/a19,0) FROM p WHERE a20 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT '2021_roster_missing_pair_zero',m,COALESCE(a20*a20/a19,0) FROM p WHERE a21 IS NOT NULL),mon AS (SELECT variant,m,COUNT(*) n,AVG(v) a FROM v GROUP BY 1,2),r AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY variant ORDER BY a) rn,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY variant) cnt FROM mon) SELECT variant,AVG(a) median_raw,AVG(ROUND(a,2)) median_round_monthly FROM r WHERE rn IN ((cnt+1)/2,(cnt+2)/2) GROUP BY variant

WITH h AS (SELECT s.prod_id,t.calendar_year y,t.calendar_month_number m,SUM(amount_sold) a FROM sales s JOIN customers c USING(cust_id) JOIN countries co USING(country_id) JOIN times t USING(time_id) JOIN promotions p USING(promo_id) JOIN channels ch USING(channel_id) WHERE co.country_name='France' AND p.promo_total_id=1 AND ch.channel_total_id=1 AND t.calendar_year IN(2019,2020,2021) GROUP BY 1,2,3),p AS (SELECT prod_id,m,MAX(CASE WHEN y=2019 THEN a END) a19,MAX(CASE WHEN y=2020 THEN a END) a20,MAX(CASE WHEN y=2021 THEN a END) a21 FROM h GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT m,SUM(a19>0 AND a20 IS NOT NULL) pairs,SUM(a19>0 AND a20 IS NOT NULL AND a21 IS NOT NULL) pairs_with_2021,AVG(CASE WHEN a19>0 AND a20 IS NOT NULL AND a21 IS NOT NULL THEN a20*a20/a19 END) restricted_mean FROM p GROUP BY m ORDER BY m

WITH h AS (SELECT s.prod_id,t.calendar_year y,t.calendar_month_number m,SUM(amount_sold) a FROM sales s JOIN customers c USING(cust_id) JOIN countries co USING(country_id) JOIN times t USING(time_id) JOIN promotions p USING(promo_id) JOIN channels ch USING(channel_id) WHERE co.country_name='France' AND p.promo_total_id=1 AND ch.channel_total_id=1 AND t.calendar_year IN(2019,2020,2021) GROUP BY 1,2,3),p AS (SELECT prod_id,m,MAX(CASE WHEN y=2019 THEN a END) a19,MAX(CASE WHEN y=2020 THEN a END) a20,MAX(CASE WHEN y=2021 THEN a END) a21 FROM h GROUP BY 1,2),mon AS (SELECT m,AVG(ROUND(a20*a20/a19,2)) a,SUM(a21 IS NULL) missing_2021 FROM p WHERE a19>0 AND a20 IS NOT NULL AND a21 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m),r AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY a) rn,COUNT(*) OVER() cnt FROM mon) SELECT m,a,rn,AVG(a) OVER() mean_all FROM r WHERE rn IN ((cnt+1)/2,(cnt+2)/2)
